sk.consent.microphone.title: {app} wants to use your microphone
sk.consent.microphone.body: If you allow it, {app} can record from your microphone, now and next time. Your choice is remembered for this app.
sk.consent.camera.title: {app} wants to use your camera
sk.consent.camera.body: If you allow it, {app} can record video from your camera, now and next time. Your choice is remembered for this app.
sk.crash.title: {app} ran into a problem
sk.crash.body: An internal error stopped the app. Restart it to keep going.
sk.crash.body_no_restart: An internal error stopped the app. Close it and open it again to keep going.
